entities.summary: Joseph Aloysius Kennedy is a retired American professional basketball player who competed in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for two seasons and the American Basketball Association (ABA) for one season. He played college basketball for the Duke Blue Devils, and played professionally for the Seattle SuperSonics of the NBA, and finally the Pittsburgh Condors of the ABA.
